items.stem: Which TWO are good voice-editing practices? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Comp the best phrases from multiple takes
options.rationale: Correct: comping builds the strongest performance.

options.text: Apply noise reduction gently to avoid artefacts
options.rationale: Correct: light cleanup preserves natural tone.

options.text: Push noise reduction to maximum on every clip
options.rationale: Heavy NR makes the voice robotic.

options.text: Leave all plosives and clicks in the final cut

items.explanation: Correct: comping builds the strongest performance.
